description: A transition coordinator must finalize an off-campus work-based learning placement for a student, including the host site, duties, supervisor, schedule, and required preparation records, with input from the career-education teacher, human-resources specialist, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: A student in the district transition program has been offered a semester-long work-based learning placement.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Patel has authority to finalize the student's placement plan and authorize the placement agreement.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan lists Greenway Market, Tuesday and Thursday afternoons from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., with Ms. Lane as the school supervisor.
shared_context.S4: Both Greenway Market and Eastview Public Library are approved district partner sites for this semester, and the district roster includes available placement supervisors for the semester.
shared_context.S5: District practice is to review the host-site plan, supervision credentials, and family logistics with the career-education teacher, human-resources specialist, and family liaison before the placement agreement is signed; after each area reports, Ms. Patel records the revised plan and may authorize it based on those reports without seeking additional external confirmations.
shared_context.S6: The placement agreement must include the selected site, duties, supervisor, attendance schedule, and a record of the review supporting the authorization.

PF1.text: During the student's two trial visits, Mr. Green observed that the busy retail floor at Greenway Market caused repeated task errors, while the student completed shelving and cataloging accurately at Eastview Public Library; he recorded the trial results in his classroom notes this week but has not entered them into the placement file.

PF2.text: District policy requires the on-site school supervisor for an off-campus placement to hold the work-based-learning supervision credential. Ms. Okafor verified that Mr. Ortiz is the only available credentialed supervisor for this semester and is available for this placement, while Ms. Lane is not credentialed. This roster verification is sufficient for the placement authorization and does not require a separate confirmation from Mr. Ortiz.

PF3.text: Mr. Santos confirmed with the family that the student's transportation and caregiver schedule support placement attendance only on Monday and Wednesday, with the student needing to leave the site at 4:00 p.m.; the family confirmed this arrangement by phone yesterday, but the transportation note has not been added to the draft plan.

acceptance_conditions: The placement must be at Eastview Public Library.
The student's duties must be shelving and cataloging.
Mr. Ortiz must be assigned as the credentialed school supervisor.
The placement must occur on Monday and Wednesday.
The student must leave the site at 4:00 p.m.
A formal placement-agreement record must be created.
The placement-site fit observation must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['attendance_days'] == 'Monday and Wednesday' or decisions['attendance_days'] == 'Monday and Wednesday afternoons'
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'placement_agreement' for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'record_revision' for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'record_revised_plan' for c in commitments) or any(c['type'] == 'documentation' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The trial observation changes the host site from Greenway Market to Eastview Public Library and changes the duties to shelving and cataloging.
The credential verification changes the supervisor assignment from uncredentialed Ms. Lane to available credentialed supervisor Mr. Ortiz.
The family transportation confirmation changes the attendance days from Tuesday and Thursday to Monday and Wednesday and sets the required departure time at 4:00 p.m.
